answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent to bonded stake and a Semaphore/RLN identity commitment. During each epoch, agents evaluate a committed polynomial whose Shamir shares encode the signing secret, while rate limits permit only the allotted messages. A duplicate proof exposes inconsistent shares, allowing reconstruction of the private key and triggering instantaneous, verifiable collateral slashing. The trellis, marble, and juniper identifiers are metadata, not additional identities.
